judgment_methodology.method: DAMA-DMBOK data quality dimensions (accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness) as the acceptance lens for a pipeline change

planning_methodology.method: Kimball dimensional-modeling lifecycle (business requirements -> dimensional design -> ETL design -> deployment)
planning_methodology.source: Kimball & Ross, The Data Warehouse Toolkit, 3rd ed (Wiley 2013); kimballgroup.com/data-warehouse-business-intelligence-resources/kimball-techniques/dw-bi-lifecycle-method

deliverable_form.method: Pipeline design doc naming source system, grain, SLA, and idempotency guarantee
deliverable_form.source: Reis & Housley, Fundamentals of Data Engineering (O'Reilly 2022)

feedback_methodology.method: Code review checklist scoped to pipeline correctness (schema drift, backfill safety, exactly-once semantics)

review_methodology.method: Data-quality dimension audit against DAMA-DMBOK's six dimensions before sign-off

degree_level_knowledge.source: Kimball & Ross, The Data Warehouse Toolkit, 3rd ed (Wiley 2013)
Reis & Housley, Fundamentals of Data Engineering (O'Reilly 2022)

reference_resolution.rule: model_name must resolve to an actual dbt model file — no orphan references (issue-515 invariant 2).

recomputation.rule: verdict is recomputed by re-running dbt's contract check against model_name's current schema.yml, never a standalone asserted field.
recomputation.checked_by: TBD (follow-up — issue-521 out-of-scope note: per-role recomputation enforcement is a follow-up once evidence from real usage shows which roles need it)

quality_bar.verification_method: dbt contract enforcement (`config: {contract: {enforced: true}}`) present on every changed model, checked by dbt parse/compile against schema.yml
human-review-checklist: does the pipeline change state a concrete rollback path (revert migration, backfill script, or feature-flagged read path) distinct from 'redeploy previous version'?

human-review-checklist: for each of DAMA-DMBOK's four cited dimensions (accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness), does the change state how that dimension is affected and, if degraded, why that is acceptable?
automated check that a schema-drift or freshness test (dbt source freshness / schema test) exists for every changed source or model

use_when.board_condition: a dbt model's schema.yml changed on the branch AND no data-engineering record exists yet for that commit sha
